description: Données de consommation d'électricité des ministères en 2014 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DAE. This dataset comes from the State Procurement Directorate (DAE). It contains the electricity consumption data of the ministries in 2014 as part of the following waves of electricity purchases: Wave 1: \- Economic and Financial Ministries \- Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Forestry \- Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Development \- Court of Auditors ... Coverage: DAE. The portal shows the English title as "Electricity consumption data of ministries in 2014" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is DAE. Its keywords include energetiques, energies, electricite, ministeres, batiments, administration. The listing shows 6 download or service links in ZIP, JSON. The listing shows 2018-12-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
